data_fields.name: max_promotion_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 10000 (no effective cap when quarters are not required)

best_idea: Scale XP per kill by how far the victim's peak attack sits above the killer's, clamped between a small floor and a ceiling, so farming weak enemies earns almost nothing and a strong upset earns the most.
decision_why: The gap-scaled gain with a floor is what Frankendom lacks (its XP is per-monster and flat), but the peak must come from the verified duel attack (not a buff spike), XP must be integer milli-XP, many-on-one needs a credit rule for MAX_ATTACKERS = 3, and the proximity credit and leader-carry rule do not fit one ledger.
acceptance: A server test: a victim whose peak attack is 10 or more above the killer's gives the ceiling gain (3000 milli-XP); equal peaks give 500 milli-XP; a victim 2 or more points weaker gives the 20 milli-XP floor; the level event fires once when the whole-number part changes.
